user.title: Kessil WiFi Dongle
user.description: IP address of the dongle in your network (TCP port 8888 must be reachable from Home Assistant).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the dongle. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant can reach TCP port 8888.

export_programs.name: Export programs
export_programs.description: Returns all programs stored in the dongle for the lamp type of a group, in the format save_program accepts. Use it as a backup.

entity_id.name: Lamp group
entity_id.description: Light entity of the Kessil lamp group.

save_program.name: Save program
save_program.description: Creates a program in the dongle, or overwrites the user program with the same name. Presets cannot be overwritten. The program is not started.

entity_id.name: Lamp group
entity_id.description: Light entity of the Kessil lamp group; the program is saved for its lamp type.

points.name: Points
points.description: 2–20 points: minutes after midnight, UI (5 channel values), optional eid (effect: 0 thunderstorm, 1 clouds, 2 rainbow, 3 aurora), duration (30–300 s) and freq (0–2). At least one point needs intensity 0.

rename_program.name: Rename program
rename_program.description: Renames a user program in the dongle. Presets cannot be renamed.

entity_id.name: Lamp group
entity_id.description: Light entity of the Kessil lamp group.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New program name, at most 31 bytes.

delete_program.name: Delete program
delete_program.description: Deletes a user program from the dongle. Presets and running programs cannot be deleted.

entity_id.name: Lamp group
entity_id.description: Light entity of the Kessil lamp group.

program.name: Program
program.description: Name of the program to delete.
